findings.title: Financing authority unnamed; financed-book NOT_MEASURABLE fail-closed branch missing
findings.evidence: Plan §4 F4 and §8 require financing 'adjudicated per arm x leg x fold BEFORE merge' and dual-books sign non-inversion, but name NO citable swap/financing band source for the 5 TD majors. A2 inventory_gaps_honest states TD daily payloads carry OHLC only (no swap points). A4 axis-5 binding_requirements #2 (verbatim): 'the plan must name its financing authority BEFORE D1; if none exists in the authorized evidence space, the financed book is NOT_MEASURABLE and the cycle must say so rather than assume zero financing' — citing NG6 P0-F4 (cost authority unmeasurable -> fail-closed family kill, ledger FOREX-NG6 row). The plan adopts the A4 cost-floor contract but omits this financing clause entirely.
findings.attack_path: An implementer scores a 'financed' book with implicit zero financing; financing==0 makes the financed book a cost-only clone of the price-only book; the dual-books inversion gate becomes near-tautological and the ~5.1bps-over-3-nights NZD sign-flip exposure the plan itself cites goes unmeasured. Invalid-PASS path.
findings.remediation: Amend F4/§8: pin the conservative financing band + its authority at P0 (or in D1 freeze), and add the fail-closed branch: no citable band in the authorized evidence space => financed book NOT_MEASURABLE, declared per NG6 P0-F4 class, never silently zero.
